summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by B2Gold Corp. reporting its Q2 2026 operational and financial results via press release. The release highlights gold production, costs, net income, and a share repurchase under a normal course issuer bid. No special-situation transaction (acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, etc.) is described; the sale of Finland properties is mentioned only as a past event affecting financials. The repurchase is routine. Therefore, this is an ordinary earnings disclosure, not a special situation.
